title: x ↦ x + tZ(x) and its derivative are injective when |t|·sup‖DZ‖ < 1
statement: Small perturbations of the identity. Data: P ∈ ℕ; Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P; Λ, t ∈ ℝ. Hypotheses: Z is C¹; ‖DZ(x)‖ ≤ Λ for every x ∈ ℝ^P; |t|Λ < 1. Conclusion: the map Φ(x) := x + tZ(x) is injective; DΦ(x) = I + tDZ(x) for every x; and DΦ(x) is injective for every x. (D = fderiv ℝ.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ t : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ Z x‖ ≤ Λ) → |t| * Λ < 1 → Injective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ (∀ x, fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) + t • fderiv ℝ Z x) ∧ ∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)
